title: COVID-19 Test - SAO++ edition
notes: SAO++ power select: the switch common (VLOAD) feeds the timer and both LEDs. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.
The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.
Nothing is wired to SDA, SCL, GPIO1 or GPIO2, so no series diode is needed on the cell (docs/standard.md section 3).
555 astable, as the maker drew it: R1 = RA (VLOAD to DIS), R2 = RB (DIS to THR/TRIG), C1 = timing capacitor.
3.3M + 3.3M + 100n: D2 on 0.46 s, off 0.23 s (about 1.5 blinks a second). The maker's built board (1k, 470k, 1u) gave 0.33 s on, 0.33 s off.
D1 = control line C, always lit (R3). D2 = test line T, blinks from the 555 output (R4). Red LEDs, 1.3k each: about 1 mA from a cell.
C2 = supply decoupling next to the timer (not in the maker's circuit; same part as C1).
